name: MoonHacker vault unauthenticated Aave flash-loan callback
summary: MoonHacker vaults' Aave flash-loan callback executeOperation checked neither msg.sender nor initiator and took the market address from caller params. The attacker called it directly: each vault repaid its Moonwell USDC debt with attacker USDC and redeemed its collateral to the attacker, or approved the redeemed USDC to an attacker contract posing as mToken.
notes: Four byte-identical vaults of different owners ran in the anchor (one empty); all are targets and the youngest sets the age.

The vaults' redeemed mUSDC collateral is valued net of the Moonwell debt the attacker's flash-loaned USDC repaid: 1,733,224.22 redeemed minus 1,413,794.69 repaid = 319,429.53 USDC at DefiLlama's USDC price.
Later direct executeOperation calls by 0xc1268f1e in blocks 129705684-5 moved no tokens and are not campaign.
